# get dataframe ready
```{r read in pilot data & apply exclusion criteria}
# import MTurk data
data1 <- read_csv("./data/exp-1-pilot/00.exp1-pilot-raw-batch1.csv")
data1_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-1-pilot/01.exp1-pilot-attnchecks-batch1.csv")
data <- rbind(data1)
attn_checks <- rbind(data1_attnchecks)

# filter based on color question
L_filtered_id <- attn_checks %>%
  filter(attn_check_1=="yellow") %>%
  distinct(unique_id) # all participants answered this question correctly

# set up trial names, create and select relevant columns
L_data <- data%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% L_filtered_id$unique_id)%>%
  mutate(data_type="within subjects",
         manipulation_type = case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "1 agent,")==TRUE ~ "baseline",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "attention_checks")==TRUE ~ "attention_checks",
                                 TRUE ~ "main"),
         A_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "intentional")==TRUE ~ "intentional drop",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "no drop")==TRUE ~ "no drop-off",
                                       TRUE ~ "accidental drop"),
         B_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "pickup")==TRUE ~ "intend to own",
                                         str_detect(trial_condition, "walkaway")==TRUE ~ "no intent to own",
                                       TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         B_knowledge=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "aware")==TRUE ~ "knowledgeable",
                                    str_detect(trial_condition, "ignorant")==TRUE ~ "ignorant",
                                    TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         blue_agent_first=case_when(str_detect(agent_order, "A_2,A_1")==TRUE ~ FALSE,
                                       TRUE ~ TRUE))%>%
  select(unique_id,data_type,trial_condition,manipulation_type,A_intentionality,B_intentionality,B_knowledge,
         blue_agent_first, A1_slider_value, A2_slider_value, object_cost,id)

# extract object cost judgments
L_data_object_cost <-L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="attention_checks")%>%
  select(unique_id, object_cost)

# add object cost judgments to ownership judgment data
L_data_long <- L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type!="attention_checks")%>%
  rename(A=A1_slider_value, B = A2_slider_value)%>%
  gather(agent, value, A,B)%>%
  select(-object_cost)%>%
  left_join(L_data_object_cost)

L_data_long$object_cost <- as.numeric(L_data_long$object_cost)
L_data_long$value <- as.numeric(L_data_long$value)
L_data_long$agent <- factor(L_data_long$agent, levels=c("A", "B"))

# exclude participants
## note: applied a loose filtering criteria, which is that 1 of the agent B's ownership rating is <= 10 for baseline trials
baseline_data<- L_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & agent=="B")%>% 
  spread(agent,value)%>%
  spread(trial_condition,B)

baseline_wide <- baseline_data%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise_all(function(x){x[!is.na(x)]})%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")

strict_baseline_filter_id <- baseline_wide%>%
  filter(`1 agent,accidental`<=10 | `1 agent,intentional`<=10 | `1 agent,no drop`<=10)%>% # criteria used for pilot data
  select(unique_id)

strict_baseline_filtered_data_long <- L_data_long%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)
```

# create useful support functions
## voronoi partition
```{r build functions}
create_VoronoiDiagram <- function(Hypothesis){
  X = Hypothesis$x
  Y = Hypothesis$y
  dxy  <- deldir(X,Y,rw=c(0,100,0,100))
  tiles <- tile.list(dxy)
  return(tiles)
}

evaluate_OwnershipVariability <- function(A_rating, B_rating, tiles){
  #ownership_ratings: participant rating for A (y) and B (x)'s ownerships
  #voronoi_specifications: a hypothesis with two lists of centroid coords
  i <- which.tile(B_rating, A_rating,tiles)
  return(i)
}

get_Voronoi_freq <- function(which_df){
  num_agents <- length(unique(which_df$unique_id))
  voronoi_freq_groups <- which_df%>%
    group_by(trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group)%>%
    summarise(mean=n()/num_agents)%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(n=num_agents,
           which_Voronoi_group_text= case_when(which_Voronoi_group==1 ~ "G1\nneither A or B owns",
                                               which_Voronoi_group==2 ~ "G2\nA owns, B doesn't",
                                               which_Voronoi_group==3 ~ "G3\nunsure",
                                               which_Voronoi_group==4 ~ "G4\nA doesn't, B owns",
                                               which_Voronoi_group==5 ~ "G5\nBoth A and B own"))%>%
  select(trial_condition,n,mean, which_Voronoi_group_text)
  return(voronoi_freq_groups)
}
```

```{r create Voronoi space}
x_1 = 18.37710
x_3 = 81.62270	
y_1 = 18.37710
y_3 = 81.62270	
H = data.frame(x=c(x_1,x_1,50,x_3,x_3),
        y=c(y_1,y_3,50,y_1,y_3))
chosen_tiles <- create_VoronoiDiagram(H)
    
area1 <- chosen_tiles$pt.1$area
area2 <- chosen_tiles$pt.2$area
area3 <- chosen_tiles$pt.3$area
area4 <- chosen_tiles$pt.4$area
area5 <- chosen_tiles$pt.5$area
```

# pilot data result
```{r}
Main_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
  spread(agent,value)

Baseline_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline")%>%
  spread(agent,value)

# assign Voronoi group to participants
data_voronoi <- Main_conditions%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(which_Voronoi_group = evaluate_OwnershipVariability(A,B, chosen_tiles))

data_voronoi_baseline <- Baseline_conditions%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(which_Voronoi_group = evaluate_OwnershipVariability(A,B, chosen_tiles))

all_voronoi <- rbind(data_voronoi, data_voronoi_baseline)
Main_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq <- get_Voronoi_freq(data_voronoi)
Baseline_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq <- get_Voronoi_freq(data_voronoi_baseline)

# binomial testing for baseline trials:
strict_baseline_voronoi_freq<- Baseline_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq%>%
  select(trial_condition, which_Voronoi_group_text, mean, n)%>%
  ungroup()

baseline_binom_df <- strict_baseline_voronoi_freq%>% 
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(nSuccess = n*mean,
         pSuccess = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$estimate,3),
         pValue = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$p.value,3))%>%
  mutate(is_a_theory = case_when(pSuccess>0.2 ~ TRUE, #did not include "& pValue < .05" for pilot data
                                 TRUE ~ FALSE),
         trial_condition = factor(trial_condition, levels=c("1 agent,intentional",
                                                            "1 agent,accidental","1 agent,no drop")))%>%
  select(trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group_text,is_a_theory,pSuccess,pValue,nSuccess,n)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)

baseline_trial_condition_no <- baseline_binom_df%>%
  group_by(trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(n())%>%
  mutate(trial_no=1:n())%>%
  select(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  ungroup()

baseline_binom_df_isTheory <- baseline_trial_condition_no%>%
  left_join(baseline_binom_df)%>%
  filter(is_a_theory==TRUE)%>%
  select(-is_a_theory)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)

df_baseline_no_theories <- baseline_binom_df_isTheory%>%
  group_by(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(no_significant_theories=n())%>%
  select(trial_no, trial_condition, no_significant_theories)

# binomial testing for main trials:
strict_data_voronoi_freq<- Main_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq%>%
  select(trial_condition, which_Voronoi_group_text, mean, n)%>%
  ungroup()

binom_df <- strict_data_voronoi_freq%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(nSuccess = n*mean,
         pSuccess = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$estimate,3),
         pValue = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$p.value,3))%>%
  mutate(is_a_theory = case_when(pSuccess>0.2 ~ TRUE, #did not include "& pValue < .05" for pilot data
                                 TRUE ~ FALSE),
         trial_condition = factor(trial_condition, levels = c("2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup",
                                                              "2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway",
                                                              "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup",
                                                              "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway",
                                                              "2 agents,intentional,aware,pickup",
                                                              "2 agents,intentional,aware,walkaway",
                                                              "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,pickup",
                                                              "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,walkaway")))%>%
  select(trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group_text,is_a_theory,pSuccess,pValue,nSuccess,n)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)

trial_condition_no <- binom_df%>%
  group_by(trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(n())%>%
  mutate(trial_no=1:n())%>%
  select(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  ungroup()

binom_df_isTheory <- trial_condition_no%>%
  left_join(binom_df)%>%
  filter(is_a_theory==TRUE)%>%
  select(-is_a_theory)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)

df_no_theories <- binom_df_isTheory%>%
  group_by(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(no_significant_theories=n())%>%
  select(trial_no, trial_condition, no_significant_theories)
```


# simulation
```{r function}
run_all_simulations <- function(num_sim, num_sample, pilot_data_wide, included_ids, data_object_cost){
  # generate dataframes to store output
  df_simulation_data <- data.frame()
  df_simulation_voronoi_freq <- data.frame()
  df_simulation_binom <- data.frame()
  
  for(current_sim_num in 1:num_sim){
    print(current_sim_num)
    
    # generate the simulated dataset
    trials <- rep(trial_condition, num_sample)
    sampled_unique_id <- rep(sample(included_ids$unique_id, num_sample, replace = T), each=11) #11 total trials
    sim_id <- rep(paste(current_sim_num, 1:num_sample, sep="-"),each=11)
    single_sim_data <- cbind(sampled_unique_id, sim_id,
                             trials)%>%
      as.data.frame()%>%
      rename(unique_id=sampled_unique_id,
             trial_condition=trials)%>%
      left_join(pilot_data_wide)
    single_sim_data_long<- single_sim_data%>%
      rename(A=A1_slider_value, B = A2_slider_value)%>%
      gather(agent, value, A,B)%>%
      select(-object_cost)%>%
      left_join(data_object_cost)%>%
      select(-unique_id)%>%
      rename(unique_id=sim_id)
    single_sim_data_long$object_cost <- as.numeric(single_sim_data_long$object_cost)
    single_sim_data_long$value <- as.numeric(single_sim_data_long$value)
    single_sim_data_long$agent <- factor(single_sim_data_long$agent, levels=c("A", "B"))
    
    # prepare dataframe for voronoi
    Main_conditions<-single_sim_data_long%>%
      filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
      spread(agent,value)
    
    Baseline_conditions<-single_sim_data_long%>%
      filter(manipulation_type=="baseline")%>%
      spread(agent,value)
   
   # assign Voronoi group to participants
   data_voronoi <- Main_conditions%>%
      rowwise()%>%
      mutate(which_Voronoi_group = evaluate_OwnershipVariability(A,B, chosen_tiles))
    
   data_voronoi_baseline <- Baseline_conditions%>%
      rowwise()%>%
      mutate(which_Voronoi_group = evaluate_OwnershipVariability(A,B, chosen_tiles))
    
   all_voronoi <- rbind(data_voronoi, data_voronoi_baseline)
   Main_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq <- get_Voronoi_freq(data_voronoi)
   Baseline_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq <- get_Voronoi_freq(data_voronoi_baseline)
   
   # binomial testing for baseline trials:
    strict_baseline_voronoi_freq<- Baseline_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq%>%
      select(trial_condition, which_Voronoi_group_text, mean, n)%>%
      ungroup()%>%mutate(sim_num=current_sim_num)
    
    baseline_binom_df <- strict_baseline_voronoi_freq%>% 
      rowwise()%>%
      mutate(nSuccess = n*mean,
             pSuccess = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$estimate,3),
             pValue = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$p.value,3))%>%
      mutate(is_a_theory = case_when(pSuccess>0.2 & pValue < .05 ~ TRUE,
                                     TRUE ~ FALSE),
             trial_condition = factor(trial_condition, levels=c("1 agent,intentional",
                                                                "1 agent,accidental","1 agent,no drop")))%>%
      select(sim_num, trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group_text,is_a_theory,pSuccess,pValue,nSuccess,n)%>%
      arrange(trial_condition)
    
    baseline_trial_condition_no <- baseline_binom_df%>%
      group_by(trial_condition)%>%
      summarise(n())%>%
      mutate(trial_no=1:n())%>%
      select(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
      ungroup()
    
    baseline_binom_df_isTheory <- baseline_trial_condition_no%>%
      left_join(baseline_binom_df)%>%
      filter(is_a_theory==TRUE)%>%
      select(-is_a_theory)%>%
      arrange(trial_condition)
      
    df_baseline_no_theories <- baseline_binom_df_isTheory%>%
      group_by(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
      summarise(no_significant_theories=n())%>%
      select(trial_no, trial_condition, no_significant_theories)
    
    # binomial testing for main trials:
    strict_data_voronoi_freq<- Main_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq%>%
      select(trial_condition, which_Voronoi_group_text, mean, n)%>%
      ungroup()%>%mutate(sim_num=current_sim_num)
    
    binom_df <- strict_data_voronoi_freq%>%
      rowwise()%>%
      mutate(nSuccess = n*mean,
             pSuccess = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$estimate,3),
             pValue = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$p.value,3))%>%
      mutate(is_a_theory = case_when(pSuccess>0.2 & pValue < .05 ~ TRUE,
                                     TRUE ~ FALSE),
             trial_condition = factor(trial_condition, levels = c("2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup",
                                                                            "2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway",
                                                                            "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup",
                                                                            "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway",
                                                                            "2 agents,intentional,aware,pickup",
                                                                            "2 agents,intentional,aware,walkaway",
                                                                            "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,pickup",
                                                                            "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,walkaway")))%>%
      select(sim_num, trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group_text,is_a_theory,pSuccess,pValue,nSuccess,n)%>%
      arrange(trial_condition)
    
    trial_condition_no <- binom_df%>%
      group_by(trial_condition)%>%
      summarise(n())%>%
      mutate(trial_no=1:n())%>%
      select(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
      ungroup()
    
    binom_df_isTheory <- trial_condition_no%>%
      left_join(binom_df)%>%
      filter(is_a_theory==TRUE)%>%
      select(-is_a_theory)%>%
      arrange(trial_condition)
      
    df_no_theories <- binom_df_isTheory%>%
      group_by(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
      summarise(no_significant_theories=n())%>%
      select(trial_no, trial_condition, no_significant_theories)
    
  # write the dataframe with all simulated data
    df_simulation_data <- df_simulation_data%>%rbind(single_sim_data_long)
    df_simulation_voronoi_freq <- df_simulation_voronoi_freq%>%
      rbind(baseline_binom_df, binom_df)
  # write the binomial results
    num_2sig_accidental_main <- df_no_theories%>%
      ungroup()%>%
      filter(trial_no %in% c(1,2,3,4))%>% # the accidental main trials
      filter(no_significant_theories==2)%>%
      summarise(n=n())%>%
      as.numeric()

    num_2sig_accidental_baseline<- df_baseline_no_theories%>%
      ungroup()%>%
      filter(trial_no %in% c(2))%>% # the accidental baseline trial
      filter(no_significant_theories==2)%>%
      summarise(n=n())%>%
      as.numeric()
    
    num_2sig_intentional_main <- df_no_theories%>%
      ungroup()%>%
      filter(trial_no %in% c(5,6,7,8))%>% # the intentional main trials
      filter(no_significant_theories==2)%>%
      summarise(n=n())%>%
      as.numeric()

    num_2sig_intentional_baseline<- df_baseline_no_theories%>%
      ungroup()%>%
      filter(trial_no %in% c(1,3))%>% # the intentional baseline trial
      filter(no_significant_theories==2)%>%
      summarise(n=n())%>%
      as.numeric()
    
    is_hypothesis_sig <- (num_2sig_accidental_baseline+num_2sig_accidental_main)>=1|
      (num_2sig_intentional_baseline+num_2sig_intentional_main)>=1
    
  df_simulation_binom <- df_simulation_binom%>%rbind(c(current_sim_num,
                                                       num_2sig_accidental_baseline+num_2sig_accidental_main,
                                                       num_2sig_intentional_baseline+num_2sig_intentional_main,
                                                     is_hypothesis_sig))
  colnames(df_simulation_binom) <- c("sim_num", "num_2sig_accidental", "num_2sig_intentional", "is_hypothesis_sig")
  }
  
  return(list(df_simulation_binom,df_simulation_voronoi_freq,df_simulation_data))
}
```


```{r run simulation}
set.seed(1)
trial_condition <- unique(L_data_long$trial_condition)
simulation_list_v1<- run_all_simulations(num_sim=10000, num_sample=120, pilot_data_wide=L_data, included_ids=strict_baseline_filter_id, data_object_cost=L_data_object_cost)
df_simulation_binom_v1 <- simulation_list_v1[[1]] # this only accounted for multiple intuitions in accidental trials
df_simulation_freq_v1 <- simulation_list_v1[[2]]
df_simulation_data_v1 <- simulation_list_v1[[3]]
```

```{r export simulation data}
write_csv(df_simulation_binom_v1, "./data/exp-1-pilot/02.exp.1-pilot-poweranalysis-10000sim-summary.csv")
write_csv(df_simulation_freq_v1, "./data/exp-1-pilot/03.exp.1-pilot-poweranalysis-10000sim-binom-freq.csv")
write_csv(df_simulation_data_v1, "./data/exp-1-pilot/04.exp.1-pilot-poweranalysis-10000-binom-data.csv")
```

```{r import simulation data}
df_simulation_binom_v1 <- read_csv( "./data/exp-1-pilot/02.exp.1-pilot-poweranalysis-10000sim-summary.csv")
```

```{r calculate power}
df_simulation_binom_v1%>%
  filter(num_2sig_accidental>=1|num_2sig_intentional>=1)%>%
  summarise(power=n()/10000)
```
